name: Orderly
description: Hand-authored app graph for a small Uno Platform ordering app. Three features, five screens, four MVUX models (CartViewModel is shared by Cart and Checkout), one shared OrderLineRow component with three uses, six routes, twelve declared states, one inferred relationship.

lines: private static void RegisterRoutes(IViewRegistry views, IRouteRegistry routes)
public partial record CatalogModel(ICatalogService Catalog, ICartService Cart)
public IFeed<int> CartCount => Cart.Items.Select(items => items.Sum(i => i.Quantity));
public partial record ProductModel(Product Product, ICartService Cart, INavigator Navigator)
public IState<string> AddLabel => State.Value(this, () => "Add to cart");
/// Shared by CartPage and CheckoutPage (see App.xaml.cs RegisterRoutes).
public partial record CartModel(ICartService Cart, IOrderService Orders, INavigator Navigator)
public IFeed<decimal> Subtotal => Items.Select(lines => lines.Sum(l => l.Total));
public IFeed<bool> HasError => LastError.Select(e => e is not null);
public async ValueTask RemoveLine(CartLine line, CancellationToken ct)
public partial record OrdersModel(IOrderService OrderService, ICartService Cart, INavigator Navigator)

nodes.name: Added
nodes.summary: Transient. Button label reads "Added" for 600 ms before navigating.

evidence.rationale: Inverse visibility on HasItems; CheckoutButton.IsEnabled also bound to HasItems.
IsSubmitting false and LastError null; the default after the finally block.
ProgressRing.IsActive bound to IsSubmitting; CanPlaceOrder is false while submitting.

nodes.name: Disabled
nodes.summary: The button cannot be pressed. Driven by CanPlaceOrder.

evidence.rationale: Same view model type as CartPage; the purchase flow shares one model.
CatalogModel.CartCount and CartModel.Items both read ICartService.Items. There is no direct reference between the two models; the link is inferred from the shared service.

unresolved: Whether ProductCardTemplate (Catalog list item) is a reusable component used elsewhere. Not in scope of the excerpts.
Back navigation routes (system back, NavigationBar) are not modelled; only forward requests declared in source.
